notes: Box score from the Pacers' 106–104 win over the New York Knicks at Gainbridge Fieldhouse on Nov 13, 2026 (NBA Cup, East Group B): the quarter line score (26–32–27–21 to 27–22–35–20) from FOX Sports, matching the halftime (58–49) and after-three (85–84) scores in Bleacher Report, Posting and Toasting (Yahoo Sports) and the Associated Press. Points, rebounds and assists from the Bleacher Report box score; Siakam's 5 of 13 and 7 of 12 at the line from RotoWire (CBS Sports); Nesmith's 7 of 10 and 2 of 3 from three from Yahoo Sports; Brunson's 11 of 22 from Posting and Toasting; Towns' 9 of 19 from FOX Sports. Team rebounds (50–43), free throws (18 of 25 to 10 of 13) and 43 percent shooting for both teams are from the AP. The five Pacers in double figures (Yahoo Sports) account for 77 of Indiana's 106 points; no other Pacer reached 12. Indiana's biggest lead was 14 at 83–69 in the third (Bleacher Report, Posting and Toasting); New York led by 9 at 18–9 in the first. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Friday's games.

Indiana was without Tyrese Haliburton (Yahoo Sports, VAVEL); Nesmith had been limited by right knee soreness on Wednesday and was declared available Friday (AP). New York closed the third on a 15–2 run to get within 85–84 (Bleacher Report, AP); Indiana scored only 2 points in the final 4:59 (Circle City Spin). Brunson's layup cut it to 106–102 with 26 seconds left, Siakam missed two free throws with 23 seconds left, Bridges scored with 10 seconds left, Indiana turned it over with 2.8 seconds left and Towns missed a 15-foot turnaround at the buzzer (AP, Field Level Media, Posting and Toasting). Towns' 12th straight double-double to start the season is a Knicks record (Bleacher Report). The Knicks are 0–2 in group play (Field Level Media). Indiana plays at Philadelphia on Sunday at 1:00 PM ET (AP, Covers).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Pascal Siakam's 15-foot jumper with 1:49 left that put Indiana up 106–98 (AP via ABC News and CBS New York; Circle City Spin describes it as a tough jumper over Jalen Brunson). The move isn't described further, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Indiana Pacers or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Siakam's listed 6-foot-8 and 245 pounds (RealGM), in Indiana's home white with No. 43 (RealGM). No wingspan from a named source was found, so his arms are drawn to his height. He has no approved look on file yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette in the kit. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
